facts.fact: The pilot of the PINS X-Road platform interconnects the civil status databases and the national identity card system with the RNU and SIGICMU, per the communications directorate of the ministry.

SEN.note: Civil status databases named only as a pilot interconnection; no register status stated.
National data centre hosts the platform; not stated to rent to others.

facts.fact: The ministry, with JICA, is implementing an interministerial interoperable data exchange platform on X-Road, now in a pilot phase with one use case linking the RNU, SIGICMU, civil status and national identity card systems; extension to more ministries is planned.

systems.country_label: Plateforme interministérielle et interopérable d'échange de données

SEN.note: Who runs the ID system is not stated.
Pilot links registers to the ID card system; no register is said to be keyed on the ID number.
ID card system named only as an interconnected source.
A platform project only; no framework stated.

facts.fact: Sénégal Numérique S.A., under the ministry's supervision, technically operates the X-Road interoperability platform, whose central components and security servers are hosted and run in the national data centre; the ministry is to cover operating costs after the project.

SEN.note: National data centre not stated to be for hire.
Civil status databases named only in a pilot interconnection; no office entry stated.

facts.fact: The PINS pilot use case interconnects the RNU, the SIGICMU health-insurance system, civil status databases and the national identity card to enrol PNBSF beneficiary families free in community health insurance run by ANACMU.

SEN.note: RNU named only as linked in the pilot; its status is not stated.
